review_type: Internal independent native-agent source and fake-process reviews, summarized from their retained actual records. This summary is not numerical acceptance or external peer review.

original_findings.issue: Archived controls never call the native point evaluator.
original_findings.disposition: Separate Cartesian-reference point-controls wrapper assigned; must receive independent source review and actual passing controls before point pilot.

original_findings.issue: Fixed pilot underrepresents extreme input sizes; no built-in watchdog.
original_findings.disposition: Keep original six pilot and fixed largest-OC/largest-EP probes; require measured workload admission and external process-tree caps.

original_findings.issue: Archived run can exit zero with passed:false; wrapper must validate exact report roster and success.
original_findings.disposition: Specify explicit report checks and separately pinned probe execution; no archive edits.

original_findings.issue: Standalone native_wrapper.py CLI references absent independent_point_oracle_v2.cpp; its Native API and replay.py entry point remain usable.
Full84 requires omitted detail arrays and covers only 15 fixed EP paths, not the full 5994 roster.
Row exceptions preserve failures but not necessarily raw numerical residual vectors; any diagnostic follow-up must retain the original failure.

reviewed_features: Independent Cartesian nested quadrature, no native/polar reference mass reuse
OC rho-weighted offspring normalization versus EP unweighted normalization
Shared unweighted KDE normalization and nonuniform pi/unequal cell areas
All eight native point ABI outputs directly compared
Independent one-dimensional temporal exposure integration through the end
Empty future retains prehistory compensator; single-at-start event adds exposure but not its own intensity
Warnings/nonfinite/error-estimate gates, exact count and fixed component tolerances
Twenty-five fixed point cases and ten mass cases; source/DLL drift detection
Failure rows and later cases retained, with new external output and atomic checkpoints

mocked_pipeline_summary.scope: All native and reference calculations mocked. No DLL load, quadrature, real scientific input or model evaluation.

limitations: Quadrature error estimates are numerical diagnostics, not proofs of uniform accuracy.
Fixed smooth fixtures do not certify pathological scales or all historical score outputs.
Static/fake tests do not count as native numerical-control execution.

checks.name: source_and_binary_binding
checks.detail: Eight immutable archived sources, reviewed point wrapper, current guard, DLL, materialized manifest and build-receipt hashes bind every phase; matching final bindings rechecked.

checks.name: active_lease
checks.detail: Immutable lease snapshot and mutable active owner record, actual environment token hash and expiry are checked throughout supervision. Root must issue a real exclusive numerical lease, not a synthetic token.

checks.name: exact_rosters
checks.detail: Original six index-zero pilot; predetermined maximum OC/fold0/index74 and EP/fold2/index573 probes; full all 5994 rows from scratch; all 6000 materialized receipts checked.

checks.name: false_exit_and_partial_failure
checks.detail: A zero child exit does not suffice. Actual report passed flag, failed count, completeness, unique exact identities, receipt hashes, scope, finite duration/error, exact component fields and report/journal equality are validated.

checks.name: point_controls
checks.detail: Both actual archived controls and the independent 25 native point cases/10 Cartesian mass checks are mandatory; exact fixtures, eight component outputs, finite reference errors and source bindings checked.

checks.name: resource_v2
checks.detail: No N-squared matrix allocation found in reviewed native path. Fixed one-worker pilot/probes provide actual tree RSS and workload-rate inputs; full uses 1.5*w*peak plus controller allowance, 4 GiB OS headroom and hard 8 GiB tree cap.

checks.name: time_projection
checks.detail: Conservative max observed work-unit rate from six pilot and two fixed large probes; factor three, serial maximum and duplicated full-roster cost included. Publication reserve 1800 seconds enforced.

checks.name: watchdog_amendment
checks.detail: Original AccessDenied failure reproduced independently; amended finally cleanup fails closed, retains primary/cleanup errors and discovery uncertainty, respects PID creation time and uses the owned Popen handle fallback.

checks.name: read_only_scope
checks.detail: Only private review files changed; no DLL build/loading, native controls, reference quadrature or historical likelihood calls during review.

guard_remediation.original_failure: Process.children AccessDenied escaped supervise, left owned sleeper alive and wrote no supervision receipt; reviewer terminated only captured fake-process identity.
guard_remediation.change_boundary: Only live_identity/supervise code changed; prefix and all code from bindings onward byte-identical as text.

amended_recheck.scope: Owned sleeping subprocess with the original injected AccessDenied only

memory_protocol_revision.memory_order: O(N+Npre+Ntrain) per worker plus cached states and O(roster) controller; quadratic time, no quadratic native allocation
memory_protocol_revision.new_gate: Source-informed one-worker startup reserve, then measured peak projection plus explicit 4 GiB OS/other-work headroom; original 8 GiB ceiling and all time/scientific gates retained.

conditions_before_scientific_execution: Root verifies integration hashes and owns active exclusive numerical lease.
Fresh external build must have actual compiler/source/DLL provenance; wrapper only hashes this receipt and does not establish provenance itself.
Actual archived and new point controls must pass before pilot/probes.
Full admission requires actual passing six pilot/two fixed probes and exact conservative resource projection fitting remaining time and memory.
A discovery/identity uncertainty always fails the phase; verify no surviving owned process before granting another lease.
Point replay is not full84, fitted-null calibration or full historical optimizer replay.
scope_limit: Point scope checks its declared temporal/point/joint components on saved paths; it is not full84, generator reproduction, a refit, or fitted-null calibration. The fixed controls and all actual campaign outcomes require separate terminal evidence.
